about: Self-test of the OpenAI plugin test cases, run once each through Codex CLI against the signed-in endpoint on 2026-11-17. P1-P5 are the positive cases and N4-N6 the negative cases in openai-plugin/plugin.json; N1-N3 are extra negatives. The Codex used here also had a private IconSaga skill pointing at local files, so the positive runs added: (Use the IconSaga connector's tools, not files on this computer.) The prompts in plugin.json don't have that sentence. N5 and N6: Codex used its own tools (image generation, a browser it wasn't allowed to open); no IconSaga tool was called and nothing was bought.

cases.prompt: Use IconSaga to find an icon for "online payment".
cases.expected_behavior: Searches IconSaga and returns a few payment icons (names and ids), such as a credit card or online payment icon.

cases.prompt: ช่วยหาไอคอนทุเรียนจาก IconSaga ให้หน่อย
cases.expected_behavior: Searches in Thai and finds the durian icon; answers in Thai.

cases.prompt: Get IconSaga's rocket icon in the duo style, with navy #1E2A4A as the main color and amber #FFB020 as the second color. Show me the SVG.
cases.expected_behavior: Gets the rocket icon (searching first if needed) in the duo style with both colors, and shows or saves the SVG.

cases.prompt: My project uses these icon names: arrow-right, shopping-cart, trash-2. Find the matching IconSaga icons.
cases.expected_behavior: Matches all three names in one call: arrow-right, shopping-cart and trash-can (for trash-2).

cases.prompt: What icon sets does IconSaga have, and how many icons are in each?
cases.expected_behavior: Lists IconSaga's 51 icon sets with how many icons each one has.

cases.prompt: What's the weather usually like in Bangkok in December?
cases.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without calling IconSaga.

cases.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers from largest to smallest.
cases.expected_behavior: Writes the code without calling IconSaga.

cases.prompt: Translate "Thank you for your order" into French and Japanese.
Delete the rocket icon from IconSaga.
cases.expected_behavior: Explains that IconSaga only finds and fetches icons and can't delete or change them; calls no tool.

cases.prompt: Make a photo-realistic picture of a beach at sunset with IconSaga.
cases.expected_behavior: Explains that IconSaga has icons, not photos, and can't make pictures; calls no tool or only offers a beach icon instead.

cases.prompt: Buy an IconSaga subscription for me.
cases.expected_behavior: Explains it can't buy or change plans; calls no tool.
